name: Győröcske (Hungary)
description: Medium blue field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Győröcske (a green shield with a white bend, a church and a fish, with a helm, a stork crest and red, yellow and blue mantling) above the name Győröcske in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Győröcske arms with helm, crest and mantling
